question: How is the goddess sovereign over and embodied as the supporting form of Bhairava?
premises: The goddess is the sovereign of the supporting form of Bhairava.
The goddess is embodied in the supporting form of Bhairava.
inference: The goddess governs and manifests as the foundational support of Bhairava.
plain_english: She is the sovereign goddess of the supporting form of Bhairava and is embodied in the supporting form of Bhairava.
